title: Analyze a Simulated Critical Power Incident
summary: Integrate power paths, calculations, monitoring, redundancy, safety, and escalation.
objectives: Trace a synthetic critical power incident.
Calculate a safe modeled quantity and state assumptions.
Document an evidence-based escalation without hazardous action.

vocab.def: Information that supports or tests an explanation.
Passing a concern to an authorized person or team.
Unused modeled capacity kept available for variation.

sections.heading: Scenario packet
sections.body: Use the simplified path, load figures, UPS/generator states, redundant path status, and event log. Not every clue is causal.

sections.heading: Professional boundary
sections.body: This is simulation only. Never open panels, probe mains, service UPS or generators, operate switchgear, or execute professional lockout/tagout.

practice.prompt: The simulated generator state is not confirmed. What should the report say?
practice.answer: State the observed status, identify the uncertainty, and recommend authorized escalation rather than operating controls.

quiz.question: What is the correct response to an unsafe requested action?

criteria: Avoids unsafe action and chooses escalation

lab.objective: Analyze and document a synthetic critical power incident.

futureCompetencyCandidates: analyze a simulated electrical infrastructure incident
reflectionPrompt: Which action did you deliberately not take, and why?
